theory_html:
A. except (for)

We use except (for) to introduce the only thing(s) or person / people that a statement does not include:

Dùng except (for) để nêu người/vật duy nhất không nằm trong điều được nói:

  • The price of the holiday includes all meals except (for) lunch.

    Giá kỳ nghỉ bao gồm tất cả các bữa trừ bữa trưa.

  • Everyone seemed to have been invited except (for) Mrs Woodford and me.

    Có vẻ ai cũng được mời trừ bà Woodford và tôi.

  • I had no money to give him except (for) the few coins in my pocket.

    Tôi không có tiền cho anh ta ngoài mấy đồng xu trong túi.

We use except, not except for, with to-infinitives and that-clauses:

Dùng except, không dùng except for, với to-infinitive và mệnh đề that:

  • I rarely need to go into the city centre except to do some shopping.

    Tôi hiếm khi phải vào trung tâm thành phố trừ khi đi mua sắm.

  • They look just like the real thing, except that they’re made of plastic.

    Trông chúng y như thật, chỉ có điều chúng làm bằng nhựa.

We usually use except before prepositions, bare infinitives, and that-clauses including those where the word that is left out. However, informally except for is sometimes also used, although this is grammatically incorrect:

Thường dùng except trước giới từ, nguyên mẫu không to, và mệnh đề that (kể cả khi bỏ that). Tuy nhiên, trong văn thân mật đôi khi dùng except for, dù không đúng ngữ pháp:

  • There is likely to be rain everywhere today except in Wales.

    Hôm nay có thể mưa khắp nơi trừ xứ Wales.

  • There is nothing more the doctor can do except keep an eye on him.

    Bác sĩ không thể làm gì thêm ngoài việc theo dõi anh ấy.

  • They look just like the real thing, except (that) they’re made of plastic.

    Trông chúng y như thật, chỉ có điều chúng làm bằng nhựa.

We can use except for, but not except, with the meaning ‘but for’.

Có thể dùng except for, nhưng không dùng except, với nghĩa ‘but for’.

B. except (for), besides, apart from

We use except (for) to mean that something is not included in a particular statement, but we use besides to mean ‘as well as’ or ‘in addition to’. Compare:

Dùng except (for) khi điều gì đó không nằm trong điều được nói, còn besides nghĩa là ‘cũng như’ hoặc ‘ngoài ra còn’. So sánh:

  • I don’t enjoy watching any sports except (for) cricket. (= I enjoy only cricket)

    Tôi không thích xem môn thể thao nào trừ cricket.

  • Besides cricket, I enjoy watching football and basketball. (= I enjoy three sports)

    Ngoài cricket, tôi còn thích xem bóng đá và bóng rổ.

  • I haven’t read anything by her, except (for) one of her short stories.

    Tôi chưa đọc gì của bà ấy ngoài một truyện ngắn.

  • Besides her novels and poems, she published a number of short stories.

    Ngoài tiểu thuyết và thơ, bà còn xuất bản một số truyện ngắn.

Apart from can be used with the same meanings as both except (for) and besides:

Apart from có thể mang nghĩa của cả except (for) và besides:

  • I don’t enjoy watching any sports apart from cricket. (= except for)

    Tôi không thích xem môn nào ngoài cricket.

  • Apart from cricket, I enjoy watching football and basketball. (= besides; as well as)

    Ngoài cricket, tôi còn thích xem bóng đá và bóng rổ.

C. but, but for, excepted / apart / aside

We can use but with a similar meaning to except (for), particularly after negative words such as no, nobody, and nothing:

Có thể dùng but với nghĩa gần except (for), nhất là sau từ phủ định như no, nobody, nothing:

  • After the operation he could see nothing but / except (for) / apart from vague shadows.

    Sau ca mổ, anh ấy không nhìn thấy gì ngoài những bóng mờ.

  • There was no way out but / except / apart from upwards, towards the light.

    Không có lối thoát nào ngoài đi lên, về phía ánh sáng.

But for has a different meaning from except for. We use it to say what would or might have happened if the thing introduced by but for had not happened:

But for có nghĩa khác except for. Dùng nó để nói điều gì sẽ hoặc có thể đã xảy ra nếu điều được nêu sau but for không xảy ra:

  • The country would now be self-sufficient in food but for the drought last year. (= if there hadn’t been the drought …)

    Đất nước giờ đã tự túc lương thực nếu không vì đợt hạn hán năm ngoái.

  • But for the leg injury he suffered last year, he would probably have been picked for the national team by now.

    Nếu không vì chấn thương chân năm ngoái, giờ có lẽ anh ấy đã được chọn vào đội tuyển quốc gia.

However, some people use except for in the same way as but for, particularly in informal spoken English:

Tuy nhiên, một số người dùng except for giống but for, nhất là trong văn nói thân mật:

  • I’d have got there on time except for the taxi being late. (or … but for the taxi being late.)

    Tôi đã đến đúng giờ nếu không vì taxi đến muộn.

Note that we can use excepted, apart or aside after mentioning a person or thing to say that they are not included in the statement we make:

Lưu ý có thể dùng excepted, apart hoặc aside sau khi nhắc đến người/vật để nói chúng không nằm trong điều được nói:

  • It has been, 1984 excepted / apart / aside, the hottest July for the last 100 years.

    Trừ năm 1984, đây là tháng Bảy nóng nhất trong 100 năm qua.

mcq.question: I rarely need to go into the city centre ___ to do some shopping.
mcq.full: I rarely need to go into the city centre except to do some shopping.
mcq.vi: Tôi hiếm khi phải vào trung tâm thành phố trừ khi đi mua sắm.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + to-infinitive (không except for).
mcq.key: I rarely need to go into the city centre ___ to do some shopping.|except

mcq.question: They look just like the real thing, ___ that they’re made of plastic.
mcq.full: They look just like the real thing, except that they’re made of plastic.
mcq.vi: Trông chúng y như thật, chỉ có điều chúng làm bằng nhựa.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + that-clause.
mcq.key: They look just like the real thing, ___ that they’re made of plastic.|except

mcq.question: There is likely to be rain everywhere today ___ in Wales.
mcq.full: There is likely to be rain everywhere today except in Wales.
mcq.vi: Hôm nay có thể mưa khắp nơi trừ xứ Wales.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + giới từ.
mcq.key: There is likely to be rain everywhere today ___ in Wales.|except

mcq.question: There is nothing more the doctor can do ___ keep an eye on him.
mcq.full: There is nothing more the doctor can do except keep an eye on him.
mcq.vi: Bác sĩ không thể làm gì thêm ngoài việc theo dõi anh ấy.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + nguyên mẫu không to.
mcq.key: There is nothing more the doctor can do ___ keep an eye on him.|except

mcq.question: He was dressed very smartly ___ that his shoes were dirty.
mcq.full: He was dressed very smartly except that his shoes were dirty.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy ăn mặc rất lịch sự, chỉ có điều giày bẩn.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + that-clause.
mcq.key: He was dressed very smartly ___ that his shoes were dirty.|except

mcq.question: I had nothing to do ___ sit by the pool and relax.
mcq.full: I had nothing to do except sit by the pool and relax.
mcq.vi: Tôi không có việc gì làm ngoài ngồi bên hồ bơi thư giãn.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + nguyên mẫu không to.
mcq.key: I had nothing to do ___ sit by the pool and relax.|except

mcq.question: She had no choice ___ to wait for the next train.
mcq.full: She had no choice except to wait for the next train.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy không có lựa chọn nào ngoài việc đợi chuyến tàu sau.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + to-infinitive.
mcq.key: She had no choice ___ to wait for the next train.|except

mcq.question: He gave no excuse for turning up late ___ that he was tired.
mcq.full: He gave no excuse for turning up late except that he was tired.
mcq.vi: Anh ta không đưa ra lý do đến muộn nào ngoài việc mệt.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + that-clause.
mcq.key: He gave no excuse for turning up late ___ that he was tired.|except

mcq.question: I drove all the way without stopping ___ to buy petrol.
mcq.full: I drove all the way without stopping except to buy petrol.
mcq.vi: Tôi lái suốt đường không dừng trừ lúc đổ xăng.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not including; only except (not except for) before to-infinitives, that-clauses, prepositions and bare infinitives.
except (for) = không bao gồm; chỉ dùng except (không except for) trước to-infinitive, mệnh đề that, giới từ và nguyên mẫu không to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except + to-infinitive.
mcq.key: I drove all the way without stopping ___ to buy petrol.|except

mcq.question: ___ cricket, I enjoy watching football and basketball.
mcq.full: Besides cricket, I enjoy watching football and basketball.
mcq.vi: Ngoài cricket, tôi còn thích xem bóng đá và bóng rổ.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: besides = ngoài ra còn.
mcq.key: ___ cricket, I enjoy watching football and basketball.|Besides

mcq.question: ___ her novels and poems, she published a number of short stories.
mcq.full: Besides her novels and poems, she published a number of short stories.
mcq.vi: Ngoài tiểu thuyết và thơ, bà còn xuất bản một số truyện ngắn.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: besides = in addition to.
mcq.key: ___ her novels and poems, she published a number of short stories.|Besides

mcq.question: She had never been out of the country ___ a week in Ireland as a child.
mcq.full: She had never been out of the country except for a week in Ireland as a child.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy chưa từng ra nước ngoài trừ một tuần ở Ireland hồi nhỏ.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không bao gồm → except for.
mcq.key: She had never been out of the country ___ a week in Ireland as a child.|except for

mcq.question: ___ being small, Denmark is very flat, with villages linked by country roads.
mcq.full: Besides being small, Denmark is very flat, with villages linked by country roads.
mcq.vi: Ngoài việc nhỏ, Đan Mạch còn rất bằng phẳng, với các làng nối nhau bằng đường quê.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: besides + -ing = in addition to.
mcq.key: ___ being small, Denmark is very flat, with villages linked by country roads.|Besides

mcq.question: The new road will increase traffic in the area ___ damaging an area of woodland.
mcq.full: The new road will increase traffic in the area besides damaging an area of woodland.
mcq.vi: Con đường mới sẽ làm tăng giao thông trong vùng ngoài việc phá hủy một khu rừng.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: besides = in addition to.
mcq.key: The new road will increase traffic in the area ___ damaging an area of woodland.|besides

mcq.question: ___ his novels, Campbell wrote a number of biographies.
mcq.full: Besides his novels, Campbell wrote a number of biographies.
mcq.vi: Ngoài tiểu thuyết, Campbell còn viết một số tiểu sử.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: besides = in addition to.
mcq.key: ___ his novels, Campbell wrote a number of biographies.|Besides

mcq.question: There was nothing in the fridge ___ a rather mouldy piece of cheese.
mcq.full: There was nothing in the fridge except a rather mouldy piece of cheese.
mcq.vi: Trong tủ lạnh không có gì ngoài một miếng phô mai khá mốc.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except (for) = chỉ có.
mcq.key: There was nothing in the fridge ___ a rather mouldy piece of cheese.|except

mcq.question: He was unhurt in the crash ___ a bruise on his forehead.
mcq.full: He was unhurt in the crash except for a bruise on his forehead.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy không bị thương trong vụ va chạm trừ một vết bầm trên trán.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: except for = không bao gồm.
mcq.key: He was unhurt in the crash ___ a bruise on his forehead.|except for

mcq.question: I don’t enjoy watching any sports ___ cricket.
mcq.full: I don’t enjoy watching any sports apart from cricket.
mcq.vi: Tôi không thích xem môn thể thao nào ngoài cricket.
mcq.expl:
except (for) = not included; besides = as well as / in addition to; apart from = either meaning.
except (for) = không bao gồm; besides = cũng như / ngoài ra còn; apart from = cả hai nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: apart from = except for.
mcq.key: I don’t enjoy watching any sports ___ cricket.|apart from

mcq.question: After the operation he could see nothing ___ vague shadows.
mcq.full: After the operation he could see nothing but vague shadows.
mcq.vi: Sau ca mổ, anh ấy không nhìn thấy gì ngoài những bóng mờ.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: nothing but = except.
mcq.key: After the operation he could see nothing ___ vague shadows.|but

mcq.question: There was no way out ___ upwards, towards the light.
mcq.full: There was no way out but upwards, towards the light.
mcq.vi: Không có lối thoát nào ngoài đi lên, về phía ánh sáng.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: no … but.
mcq.key: There was no way out ___ upwards, towards the light.|but

mcq.question: The country would now be self-sufficient in food ___ the drought last year.
mcq.full: The country would now be self-sufficient in food but for the drought last year.
mcq.vi: Đất nước giờ đã tự túc lương thực nếu không vì đợt hạn hán năm ngoái.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: but for = if there hadn’t been.
mcq.key: The country would now be self-sufficient in food ___ the drought last year.|but for

mcq.question: ___ the leg injury he suffered last year, he would probably have been picked for the national team by now.
mcq.full: But for the leg injury he suffered last year, he would probably have been picked for the national team by now.
mcq.vi: Nếu không vì chấn thương chân năm ngoái, giờ có lẽ anh ấy đã được chọn vào đội tuyển.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: but for.
mcq.key: ___ the leg injury he suffered last year, he would probably have been picked for the national team by now.|But for

mcq.question: It has been, 1984 ___, the hottest July for the last 100 years.
mcq.full: It has been, 1984 excepted, the hottest July for the last 100 years.
mcq.vi: Trừ năm 1984, đây là tháng Bảy nóng nhất trong 100 năm qua.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: X excepted / apart / aside.
mcq.key: It has been, 1984 ___, the hottest July for the last 100 years.|excepted

mcq.question: We would have gone walking last week ___ the terrible weather.
mcq.full: We would have gone walking last week but for the terrible weather.
mcq.vi: Tuần trước chúng tôi đã đi dạo nếu không vì thời tiết quá tệ.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: but for (không except).
mcq.key: We would have gone walking last week ___ the terrible weather.|but for

mcq.question: She might have won the race ___ hitting the last fence.
mcq.full: She might have won the race but for hitting the last fence.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy có thể đã thắng nếu không vì va vào rào cuối.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: but for (không except).
mcq.key: She might have won the race ___ hitting the last fence.|but for

mcq.question: ___ the excellent directions Katerina gave me, I would have got totally lost.
mcq.full: But for the excellent directions Katerina gave me, I would have got totally lost.
mcq.vi: Nếu không nhờ chỉ dẫn tuyệt vời của Katerina, tôi đã lạc hoàn toàn.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: But for + cụm danh từ.
mcq.key: ___ the excellent directions Katerina gave me, I would have got totally lost.|But for

mcq.question: But for the interruptions caused by the bad weather, the building ___ completed by now.
mcq.full: But for the interruptions caused by the bad weather, the building would have been completed by now.
mcq.vi: Nếu không vì thời tiết xấu làm gián đoạn, tòa nhà đã hoàn thành rồi.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: but for + would have been.

mcq.question: ___ the shelter provided by the trees, the wind would have caused even more damage to the house.
mcq.full: But for the shelter provided by the trees, the wind would have caused even more damage to the house.
mcq.vi: Nếu không nhờ hàng cây che chắn, gió đã gây hư hại nhiều hơn cho ngôi nhà.
mcq.expl:
but = except after no / nobody / nothing; but for = if it hadn’t been for (informally except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
but = except sau no / nobody / nothing; but for = nếu không vì (thân mật: except for); X excepted / apart / aside.
Điểm ngữ pháp: But for.
